name: open-pdf-studio
description: Open, measure, annotate and save PDF drawings in Open PDF Studio, the free open-source PDF editor for the construction industry.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Open PDF Studio running on your computer. Claude can open PDF drawings, read and navigate pages, place scale regions, measure areas and lengths, create and edit annotations, cut vector snippets from one drawing into another, fill title blocks, place a quantity schedule on the sheet and save the result.

Everything runs locally: the extension talks to the app on 127.0.0.1 and the PDF file itself is never sent to an external service. Claude only sees what it asks for, such as a picture of the current page view.

**Before you start:** install Open PDF Studio (free, from open-aec.com). The AI link is on by default; check it under **Settings > General > AI link (MCP)**. Tools that change a document always ask for your permission.

tools.name: app_open_pdf
tools.description: Open a PDF file in a new tab of the running app.

tools.name: app_set_zoom
tools.description: Set the page-view zoom in the LIVE app.

tools.name: app_zoom_in
tools.description: Trigger one zoom-in step in the LIVE app (same as the toolbar +).

tools.name: app_zoom_out
tools.description: Trigger one zoom-out step in the LIVE app (same as the toolbar -).

tools.name: app_screenshot_view
tools.description: Capture the LIVE app as a base64 PNG.

tools.name: app_capture_region
tools.description: Render an area of a page (or the whole page) of the active document as an image at a chosen resolution, the way Home > Screenshot does: the page is rendered again at `dpi` (not the screen pixels enlarged), with the annotations as printed (no selection frames), in the view rotation the user sees.

tools.name: app_mouse_move
tools.description: Dispatch a synthetic mousemove at viewport CSS coordinates (x, y) inside the LIVE WebView.

tools.name: app_mouse_click
tools.description: Dispatch a synthetic mouse click at (x, y).

tools.name: app_mouse_drag
tools.description: Dispatch a synthetic drag from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) using `steps` interpolated mousemove events.

tools.name: app_scroll
tools.description: Dispatch a synthetic wheel event at (x, y) with delta (dx, dy) in CSS pixels.

tools.name: app_key
tools.description: Press a single key (with optional modifiers) on the focused element.

tools.name: app_type
tools.description: Type a string into the focused element.

tools.name: app_get_viewport_state
tools.description: Probe the LIVE viewport state: render engine + timing chip, active document scale/page/viewMode, pdf-viewport singleton transform, pdf-canvas backing-store + CSS rect, high-zoom tile-overlay state (visible/hidden + position+size), pdf-container CSS rect + scroll offsets, and devicePixelRatio.

tools.name: app_go_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the active document to a 1-based page number, exactly as if the user picked the page in the page box or clicked its thumbnail.

tools.name: app_set_tool
tools.description: Switch the LIVE app's active tool, exactly like clicking the ribbon button.

tools.name: app_click_element
tools.description: Click an arbitrary DOM element in the LIVE app by CSS selector (usually '#button-id').

tools.name: app_get_current_tool
tools.description: Return the LIVE app's currently active tool name (state.currentTool).

tools.name: app_merge_pdf
tools.description: Merge one or more PDF files into the active document at the given position.

tools.name: app_assistant_ask
tools.description: Submit a message into the app's assistant window as if the user typed it (opens the panel).

tools.name: app_assistant_pending
tools.description: Take the oldest assistant question waiting for an MCP client to answer (the relay provider).

tools.name: app_assistant_answer
tools.description: Answer a pending assistant question (id from app_assistant_pending).

tools.name: app_assistant_history
tools.description: Return the LIVE assistant conversation: { ok, messages:[{ role, content }] }.

tools.name: app_agent_task_pending
tools.description: Take the oldest structured agent task that an extension submitted, without the assistant window: the task moves from pending to running and no other client gets it.

tools.name: app_agent_task_result
tools.description: Answer a running agent task by its id (from app_agent_task_pending) with either result, an object that must match the task's resultSchema (unknown fields are refused), or error { message, code } when the task cannot be done.

tools.name: app_create_annotation
tools.description: Create an annotation on the LIVE app's active document WITHOUT synthetic mouse input.

tools.name: app_list_annotations
tools.description: List the active document's annotations as compact JSON (id, type, page, core geometry, colors, text/measureText, and the markup layer when it is not the default layer).

tools.name: app_get_annotation
tools.description: Return the full JSON-safe property set of one annotation by id (functions/DOM refs stripped).

tools.name: app_update_annotation
tools.description: Merge `props` onto an existing annotation (geometry, color, lineWidth, text, ...).

tools.name: app_delete_annotation
tools.description: Delete an annotation by id (records a delete-undo step and redraws).

tools.name: app_select_annotation
tools.description: Select one annotation by id so the properties panel and selection handles show it, exactly like clicking it with the select tool.

tools.name: app_clear_selection
tools.description: Clear the annotation selection and hide the properties panel.

tools.name: app_undo
tools.description: Undo the last annotation/page edit on the active document (same as Ctrl+Z).

tools.name: app_redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone edit on the active document (same as Ctrl+Y).

tools.name: app_list_tabs
tools.description: List all open document tabs: index, fileName, filePath, modified flag, active flag, pageCount, isUntitled, currentPage, annotationCount.

tools.name: app_switch_tab
tools.description: Activate the document tab at `index` (0-based, see app_list_tabs).

tools.name: app_close_tab
tools.description: Close the document tab at `index` (0-based).

tools.name: app_new_blank_pdf
tools.description: Create a new blank PDF document in a new tab (page size in PDF points; A4 portrait = 595 x 842).

tools.name: app_save_pdf
tools.description: Save the active document with all annotations baked in.

tools.name: app_set_view_mode
tools.description: Switch the active document view: 'single' page, 'continuous' vertical scroll, or 'book' (two-page spread, page 1 on the right).

tools.name: app_fit_page
tools.description: Zoom the active document so the whole page fits the viewport (same as the Fit Page button).

tools.name: app_fit_width
tools.description: Zoom the active document so the page width fills the viewport (same as the Fit Width button).

tools.name: app_get_page_count
tools.description: Return the active document's page count and current page.

tools.name: app_portfolio
tools.description: Inspect or save a PDF Collection copy, preserving component bytes, folders, schema, sort and metadata. Save pending edits first. Added files come from local paths. Folders use numeric parentId (0 for a new root); new IDs increase from the current maximum. Unsupported components are exported, never executed. saveCopy/exportComponent require a new output path; existing files are refused. New collections get a fallback cover.

tools.name: app_recognize_form
tools.description: Detect heuristic form-field candidates on selected saved PDF pages, excluding existing fields. Review/correct labels, type, bounds in unrotated PDF points, required flags, radio grouping and order before setting accepted=true. saveCopy requires the returned revision and sourceId plus a NEW PDF outputPath. Existing fields/artwork remain. OCR labels require desktop OCR; no fields are accepted automatically.

tools.name: app_search_symbols
tools.description: Search page artwork for a selected symbol rectangle in current page-view coordinates at scale 1. Review candidates before accept, which creates undoable standard count annotations without duplicating same-category counts at the same location. Search bounded to 20 pages, 1200 pixels per edge and 1000 results. Similarity is not certainty. Results expire after 20 minutes or source changes. navigate reveals a result.

tools.name: app_workbook_bindings
tools.description: Persist mappings from a named schedule on a source PDF to numeric XLSX cells. list reports source/schedule/workbook status; bind creates or explicitly rebinds an id to the active source. preview returns fresh values, CSV and provenance without writing. refresh explicitly updates only mapped workbook cells (desktop, source must be active), preserving other formulas/formatting and requesting recalculation. Formula/merged/protected targets are refused. inspectWorkbook lists worksheets; export returns portable binding data; remove disconnects.

tools.name: app_document_workflows
tools.description: Save/export (list) named version-1 document workflows, remove by name, run selected PDF paths into a separate output folder, start explicit watched input/output folders, or stop/cancel. Supported ordered steps: rotate {angle:0|90|180|270}, cropMargins {left,right,top,bottom} in unrotated PDF points, metadata {title,author,subject}. Workflow has version:1,name,suffix (letters/digits/_/-),steps. New outputs only, deterministic names and retry detection; no uploads. Watch requires the desktop app to stay open and does not resume automatically.

tools.name: app_drawing_sets
tools.description: Manage a portable version-1 multi-file drawing set. list returns manifest/root/report; capture stages active PDF pages; import validates a manifest; root selects local package root; preview returns matches/base; commit requires that base, sheets and one resolution per sheet (existing id/new/ignore). open accepts sheet id and version index. transferPreview requires source/target version records and optional dx/dy in points, both documents open and target active; transferApply requires preview id, selected source annotation ids and confirmed:true. No PDF writes; transferred markups are one undo step.

tools.name: app_sheet_links
tools.description: Build reviewed relative PDF links across a package. index lists open saved PDFs and editable page labels; scan accepts files [{documentId,path}] and index [{id,path,page,label,region:null|[left,bottom,right,top]}], optional literal prefix and caseSensitive. Existing OCR text layers are included. Returns immutable hit ids with resolved/ambiguous/missing targets and existing-link overlaps. export accepts scan id, selections [{hitId,targetId}], optional replaceExisting and a new desktop outputPath ending .zip; exports all source copies with relative GoTo/GoToR links and report, never edits originals. cancel stops scanning. Max 100 pages, 250 MB and 2000 hits.

tools.name: app_approval_routing
tools.description: Local-file-v1 electronic approval routing, no network sending or certificate signing. Explicit configure adapter/enabled:true first. draft captures the active saved PDF hash with title/revision, sequential|parallel mode, nullable expiresAt, recipients [{id,name,email}], fields [{id,recipientId,page,x,y,width,height,label}]. list shows immutable document identity, state and audit. submit requires id and confirmedHash after exact-source review; it releases for manual handoff only. receipt imports a self-reported decision bound to request/document/recipient. cancel and supersede track distinct states. verify checks an exported record hash chain, not identity authenticity. export writes original PDF plus audit/request JSON into a new desktop ZIP outputPath; no permanent login.

tools.name: app_search_documents
tools.description: Search text and optional comments in the active PDF, all open PDFs, or PDF files directly in a desktop folder. Reads open unsaved documents in memory; never saves or uploads. Returns grouped file statuses and bounded matches with page labels, snippets and coordinates. Encrypted, unreadable and textless pages are reported separately. No persistent index. Refine the query when truncated.

tools.name: app_locations
tools.description: List computed markup locations or edit named spatial zones and explicit location overrides. Mutations require the active documentId and annotationId. Zones use existing straight polygons or unrotated boxes. Reuses undo and saves metadata with the PDF.

tools.name: app_hidden_information
tools.description: Inspect structural metadata, comments, embedded files, actions and optional-content indicators in the saved active PDF. Export selected removable categories to a NEW PDF and JSON report; existing files are never overwritten. Pending changes must be saved first. Hidden/covered text, image pixels and optional-content layers are not removed; existing signatures cannot survive rewriting.

tools.name: app_print_preflight
tools.description: Inspect the saved active PDF against a reusable print profile. Reports page/object, severity, expected and observed values for fonts, image DPI, color, transparency, page boxes and output intent. Not a PDF/X or PDF/A certificate. fixTrimBoxes explicitly writes a NEW copy and report and rechecks; existing files are refused. Save pending edits first.

tools.name: app_review_ocr
tools.description: List low/unknown-confidence OCR words with page coordinates and review state, or accept/correct one word. Requires documentId; mutations also require revision and expectedText from the list to reject stale edits. Save afterward to replace the invisible OCR text layer. Never paints over the scan. Results are paginated.

tools.name: app_get_page_text
tools.description: Read existing PDF page text without mouse automation.

tools.name: app_replace_text
tools.description: Replace one existing PDF text span returned by app_get_page_text.

tools.name: app_translate_page
tools.description: Replace many text spans of one page in a single call, for example to translate the page.

tools.name: app_set_measure_scale
tools.description: Set the active document's measurement scale calibration (pixels per unit + unit, e.g.

tools.name: app_get_takeoff
tools.description: Return take-off totals for the user's named schedules (Staten): per schedule the element count, the numeric column grand totals (e.g.

tools.name: app_place_schedule
tools.description: Build a quantities schedule (Staat) from the annotations in the open document and place it on the page as a table annotation.

tools.name: app_structural_layout
tools.description: Set out a structural floor plan in one undoable step: the grid (lettered and numbered grid lines with bubbles), columns on the grid intersections, beams along the grid lines, a span-direction arrow per floor bay carrying the real span, spot elevations, position tags (position number / section / level) and - unless switched off - a quantity schedule grouped by IFC category.

tools.name: app_list_commands
tools.description: List EVERY function the app exposes: each ribbon tab, each ribbon button on every tab (label, tab, disabled/active state) plus every drawing tool.

tools.name: app_run_command
tools.description: Run any command returned by app_list_commands: activates a ribbon tab ('ribbon-tab:<tab>'), clicks the ribbon button (switching to its tab first), runs an extension action ('ext:...') or activates the tool.

tools.name: app_read_ui
tools.description: Read the LIVE app's interface as a compact accessibility-style tree, to check what a click did without a screenshot.

tools.name: app_snippet_cut
tools.description: Cut a rectangular area from a page of the active document as a VECTOR snippet (not a raster screenshot) and put it on the app's snippet clipboard.

tools.name: app_snippet_paste
tools.description: Paste the vector snippet from the snippet clipboard into the active document at real size, as a movable annotation.

tools.name: app_import_cad
tools.description: Import a DWG or DXF drawing as a vector PDF page, without opening the import dialog.

tools.name: app_export_cad
tools.description: Export pages of the current document to DXF or DWG, without opening the export dialog.

tools.name: app_print_to_pdf
tools.description: Print the current document to a PDF file, without opening the print dialog.

tools.name: app_print
tools.description: Print the current document to a printer, without opening the print dialog.

tools.name: app_list_printers
tools.description: List the printers the app knows, with the system default printer and, per printer, the driver, the port and whether it writes to a file instead of to paper.

tools.name: app_list_layers
tools.description: List the markup layers of the active document in panel order: id, name, colour, visible, printable, locked, the number of markups on it, whether it is the current layer (where new markups land) and whether it is the default layer.

tools.name: app_create_layer
tools.description: Create a markup layer in the active document, at the end of the layer list.

tools.name: app_set_layer
tools.description: Change a markup layer of the active document: switch it on or off, make it printable or not, lock or unlock it, rename it, set its colour, or make it the current layer.

tools.name: app_snippet_flatten
tools.description: Mark a pasted vector snippet as flattened: it stays visible but is no longer selectable, and on the next save it is drawn into the page content instead of being stored as an annotation.

tools.name: app_symbol_scale
tools.description: Get or set the placement scale for symbols from the symbol palette (1 = real size, 2 = twice as large).

tools.name: app_titleblock
tools.description: Read or fill the title block fields by NAME (projectnaam, adres, opdrachtgever, status, projectnr, fase, auteur, schaal, datum_eerste, wijziging, documenttype, kenmerk — whatever the title block defines).

tools.name: app_floorplan
tools.description: Draw a building floor plan with the parts related to each other, instead of loose shapes stacked on top of one another.

tools.name: app_facade_element
tools.description: Draw and edit a facade element in a floor plan: a curtain wall or a window frame, as ONE object along a line with an outer frame, mullions on the field boundaries and a panel in every field.

tools.name: app_list_system_types
tools.description: List the reusable system types (suspended ceilings, floor slabs, panel systems) of the app library, or one type by id.

tools.name: app_register_system_type
tools.description: Register a system type owned by MCP under the id mcp:<key>.

tools.name: app_update_system_type
tools.description: Update a system type owned by MCP (id mcp:<key>).

tools.name: app_open_system_type_editor
tools.description: Open the app's system type editor with the given type selected, or select it in the editor that is already open without discarding unapplied edits.

tools.name: app_get_system_geometry
tools.description: Get the geometry of one system (suspended ceiling, floor slab, panel field) in the active document, computed by the app's own geometry engine: panels with clipped outlines, grid lines, openings, trimmers, edge segments and component positions, in millimetres in the system's own frame (independent of zoom and view rotation; placement maps it onto the page).

tools.name: app_call_extension_command
tools.description: Run a structured command of a loaded extension.

tools.name: app_list_extensions
tools.description: List the app's extensions: every installed and every loaded extension with its id, name, version, installed version, whether it is loaded and activated, its status (active, failed, notLoaded, busy), the code and message of the last failure, who made the last change (ui, mcp or startup) and whether it uses an old-style id.

tools.name: app_install_extension
tools.description: Install or update an extension from a local .oppx package, without a file dialog and without restarting the app: the package is checked and unpacked by the app, then the new version is activated.

tools.name: app_reload_extension
tools.description: Reload an installed extension from disk: deactivate it, remove everything it registered (ribbon tabs, commands, annotation types, palettes, panels) and activate it again, without restarting the app.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port of the AI link in Open PDF Studio (Settings > General > AI link). Leave at 9223 unless you changed it there.
